thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 5xx rate on /v1/generate (api-prod / us-east1). 8.1% errors over last 3m. Paging oncall. https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/IN-248123

alex_k: I'm on it, joining bridge now.

priya_r: Sam is on-call today — @sam can you take the bridge?

sam: Oncall here, grabbing the bridge. First step: check recent deploys + autoscaler. Joining zoom 10.0.0.5:9999.

ops-bot: Autoscaler triggered +2 GPUs on dedicated-pool-3 at 03:14:22 UTC.

jen_m: Seeing lots of 502/503 with backend model-v2-quant, trace id example: 8f3a2b. Webhooks queue backing up for a subset of customers. CS already alerted.

cheng_w: Timeline: spike starts ~03:12 UTC, error rate peaks 03:13:30, partial recover after scale at 03:16, residual errors until ~03:22.

alex_k: Initial mitigation done: scaled pool, failed over ~30% traffic to model-v1-fallback. Please collect KV cache stats and kernel selector logs.

jen_m: Collecting cache stats now. snippet:
```
$ curl -sS http://metrics/internal/cache | jq '.evictions, .hit_rate'
[512, 0.62]
```
seeing a burst of evictions at 03:12:40.

sam: Hypothesis: concurrent cache expirations causing increased tail latency + model-v2 quant path amplifying token latency. Will keep fallback until root cause validated.

alex_k: Action items to capture in doc: 1) dump KV cache shards from affected nodes (owner: alex_k) 2) kernel selector audit for recent runtime changes (owner: cheng_w) 3) add circuit breaker on webhook route (owner: jen_m) 4) ensure model fallback policy is automatic (owner: sam). I'll create the postmortem doc and schedule.

priya_r: Scheduling postmortem: draft meeting tomorrow 10:00 PT. Owners for RCA: alex_k, cheng_w, sam. I'll draft timeline and host doc. @legal FYI in case customers escalate for SLA credits.

legal: Thanks. Please flag customers with >1% error rate for targeted notification. We may need a formal cadence.

kate_p: I'll create the postmortem doc skeleton and add an evidence folder. Targeting RCA sign-off by Friday EOD. Can owners drop links to logs/PRs here.

alex_k: Uploading artifacts now: https://redwood.atlassian/IN-248123/evidence (logs, cache dumps, tracer outputs).

jen_m: Working on PR for circuit breaker: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/456 — tests passing locally, will request review.

cheng_w: Kernel selector logs attached. quick grep:
```
$ grep "kernel_select" runtime.log | tail -n 20
[03:12:36] kernel_select: model-v2-quant -> fallback none
[03:12:36] kernel_latency_ms: 78
[03:12:36] kernel_select: model-v2-quant -> fallback kernel-alt
```
I'll correlate with deploy diffs.

sam: I'll do peer review on the draft RCA tomorrow noon. Please ensure timeline has exact UTC timestamps.

priya_r: Added action tracker to doc (owners assigned). Please update status column as you make progress. Also noted customer-impact summary: 200 customers saw >5% errors, top 10 impacted accounts listed in evidence.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Pager closed at 03:28:10 UTC. Root cause investigation stage: IN_PROGRESS. Postmortem template created: https://redwood.atlassian/IN-248123/pm-template

alex_k: Started RCA writeup skeleton. Draft hypothesis: a stampede of cache expirations combined with a quantization kernel change in v2 increased p99 latency and caused request timeouts for upstream proxies. Need to validate kernel timing and eviction pattern.

kate_p: Dry-run review scheduled 09:30 PT tomorrow — please be prepared to walk timeline and proposed contributing factors.

cheng_w: I'm running regression job to compare kernel latencies across versions; attaching short output.

sam: Once draft is up, I'll add technical notes and runbook updates. Plan to include a mitigation play: staggered cache TTLs + circuit breaker thresholds.

priya_r: Thanks everyone — keeping this open for evidence uploads and RCA edits. Will ping when draft is ready for peer review. :thumbsup:
